result:
I've blocked DG6. The candidate itself checks out, but five record-integrity and provenance conditions fail, and I can't waive any of them. None of them is a product defect.

**What holds (all checked independently)**
- **Candidate:** it recomputes to `sha256:c05864ba…` (2769 files) at `--ref 2495e036`, at HEAD and in a clone. Only meta-excluded records changed after the freeze. `decisions.md` is identical to the frozen version (D-237 was added and then moved to `progress.md`, so the net change is zero). `validate --historical --stage DG5` passes.
- **Reviewers:** the three round-12 runs are distinct, successful and sandboxed, and their sandbox hashes match. All 43 DG6 review runs report empty `external_config_changed`. No reviewer wrote product code: qa-verifier wrote only pre-freeze tests under `tests/qa/**` and `e2e/**`.
- **Reviews:** all three PASS on this candidate with full 40-hex `source_commit`s, and each covered the whole candidate, not just the round-11 diff.
- **Findings:** all 52 are CLOSED_VERIFIED by a non-owner, and `findings.json` matches the sidecars. There are no unresolved Critical/High findings and no unresolved mandatory violations.
- **F-DG6-700/740:** I re-ran both reproductions on the real stack in EN and AR (2/2 and 4/4 passed). Neither reproduces: the false "rule changed" message now appears only on a genuine 409.
- **Final verification (V15):** the product tree on 4288d7c0b equals the candidate's, all 15 `.rc` files are 0, and I found no failures in the logs.
- **Requirements:** all 48 meet the coverage rule, and `--register DG6` passes.
- **Decisions:** D-193 to D-237 are all recorded with rationale.
- **Evidence:** the reviewers disclosed and explained every non-zero exit, failed test and timeout in the logs they cite.
- **Gates:** product gates G1–G6 stay separate from DG0–DG7, and nothing claims PMI status or certification.
- **Single-run audit (D-237):** sound, because I wrote no findings or verifications sidecar, so nothing needs importing after the gate record.

**Blocking conditions** (each with a remedy in `gates/DG6.json`)
- **B1:** none of the 52 CLOSED_VERIFIED findings has a `fix_revision`. This is the same defect that blocked DG5 (D-184 B1). Note that `import-findings --fix` would reset each finding's status, so the field has to be added another way.
- **B2:** the validator's write-once check reports 51 errors:
  - review sidecars deleted from rounds 8 and 9;
  - BE-P2 and KBE-A run files deleted;
  - a candidate manifest deleted;
  - round-7 assignments modified;
  - this audit's own round-13 assignment modified in 7fa83c6.

  Fixing B2 needs your decision: either an authorized history rewrite or a clean re-gate.
- **B3:** the assignment says the killed round-9 runs' partial output "was never committed". History shows it was committed automatically and deleted by the orchestrator two minutes later, and no decision records that.
- **B4:** the closures of F-DG6-144/200/201 (all Low) are attributed to run QA-R3B. The sidecar that closed them was actually written by the killed run QA-R3. A non-owner reviewer needs to re-verify them.
- **B5:** `stages.json` lists round-9 code-security and QA records that never existed. It also gives round 12's freeze time as 03:12:24Z, while the manifest says 03:12:17Z.

**`node tools/gates/validate.mjs --stage DG6`: exit code 1**, `FAIL gate DG6 (current) (131 problems)`:

| Category | Count |
|---|---|
| My in-flight run (its `meta.json` doesn't exist yet; round 13 not yet in `stages.json`) | 2 |
| Caused by the BLOCKED decision itself (BLOCKED verdict, FAIL checks and tests) | 11 |
| B1 `fix_revision` | 52 |
| B2 write-once | 51 |
| B4 closure provenance | 12 |
| B5 stage metadata | 3 |
| Unclassified | 0 |

118 of these errors don't concern my run, so PASS can't be recorded. The full output and classification are in `13-validate-stage-DG6.log`.

The first full clone filled the scratch volume, so I removed it and worked from `--shared` clones, as the round-12 reviewers did.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG6/round-13/release-auditor.json` (verdict BLOCKED, no new findings)
- `gates/DG6.json` (decision BLOCKED)
- `test-evidence/DG6/audit/round-13/` (logs, scripts, screenshots)
